Today J dives off a sky bison into the world of Avatar the Last Airbender to examine the parallels between Aang’s latest adventure and The Legend of Korra—from the Denied and Amon’s Equalists to the Red Lotus, Zaheer’s deadly airbending, Unalaq’s giant spirit showdown, and Kuvira’s spirit-powered weapons. When those threats come together in a single villain, how does Aang handle them—and what does that tell us about his power compared to Korra?
